name: Turn a website section into an Elementor template with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Turn a website section into an Elementor template with MiroMiro

### How it works
Turn one section of any live website into an Elementor template you import into WordPress. **Set Website and Section** holds the page and the section: `hero`, `header`, `features`, `pricing`, `testimonials`, `faq`, `cta` or `footer`. **Extract Section as Elementor** loads the page in a real browser and rebuilds that section as one Elementor container with an HTML widget, styled like the original: colors, fonts, spacing, responsive and hover styles. **Save Elementor Template File** turns it into a .json file named after the site. If the section is not found, MiroMiro returns the hero and says so in `note`. If the page cannot be reached, the workflow stops with the reason. Failed calls are not charged.

### Setup
This template uses the verified community node **n8n-nodes-miromiro** (tested with version 0.1.4 on n8n 1.123).
1. On n8n Cloud, search "MiroMiro" in the nodes panel (an admin may need to turn on Verified Community Nodes). Self-hosted: Settings > Community nodes > Install `n8n-nodes-miromiro`, see https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/
2. Get a free MiroMiro API key (300 credits a month, no card): https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding
3. Open **Extract Section as Elementor** > Credential > Create new, and paste the key.
4. Set your page and section in **Set Website and Section** and click **Execute workflow**.
5. Download the file from **Save Elementor Template File**. In WordPress: Templates > Saved Templates > Import Templates.

Each section costs 10 credits. The same call again within 24 hours is free.

### Customization
For a whole page in one template, use the "Rebuild a whole page in Elementor" template instead. Send the file to Google Drive or email instead of downloading it. The text and images belong to the source site: replace them unless it is your site or your client's.

![The workflow, in case the preview does not load](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoraiaBarroso/n8n-nodes-miromiro/main/docs/templates/section-to-elementor.png)

## Choose the section

Set the page and the section to rebuild in **Set Website and Section**.

## Rebuild and save

MiroMiro rebuilds the section as an Elementor template, saved as an importable .json file.
